segments.caption: A shirtless boy in blue shorts walks toward a large, blue and yellow inflatable water slide and pool. He joins several other children already playing in the water at the base of the slide, where kids are climbing up the inflatable structure, sliding down into the splash pool, and splashing around together in the sunny backyard.
Children play and slide down a large, colorful inflatable water slide into a pool of water, with some climbing up the sides and others waiting their turn.

Children of various ages are enjoying a vibrant, multi-lane inflatable water slide on a sunny day, with kids continuously climbing up the sides, sliding down the colorful lanes, and splashing into the blue inflatable pool at the bottom.
Children joyfully climb and slide down a large, colorful inflatable water slide, splashing into the pool at the bottom as others wait their turn on the grassy, tree-lined yard.
Children energetically climb and slide down a colorful, multi-lane inflatable water slide, creating a lively and joyful scene of summer recreation.
Children climb and slide down a large, colorful inflatable water slide on a sunny day, with the camera following their joyful descent into the splash pool at the bottom.
Children play and slide down a colorful inflatable water slide in a grassy backyard, with one boy emerging and smiling, revealing a temporary sloth tattoo on his chest.
A young boy with wet hair and a cartoon sloth tattoo on his chest walks barefoot across a grassy yard toward the camera, smiling and playfully covering his face with his hand as he approaches.
